blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Commission on Audit (COA) has called out the Mandaue City government over the lack of clearly identified societal issues or development gaps that its P55.5-million “Gugma sa Pasko” program in 2025 aimed to address. The program distributed Christmas food packs to 100,000 households in December 2025. In its audit report, COA said the city’s supporting documents did not clearly establish how the distribution addressed specific socioeconomic concerns or development needs that required government intervention. The city distributed packs worth P595.25 each to households, regardless of whether they were registered under the Community-Based Monitoring System (CBMS). READ: […]...
